Abbotsford condos and townhomes: sale price, days on market and sale-to-list, May to September 2026
In September 2026 condos and townhomes in Abbotsford sold about 3% below list price, after 32 days on market on the reports’ measure (unchanged from 32 in May).

blocks.text: Abbotsford condos and townhomes: 13 months of listings, sales and prices to September 2026

Over the 13 months from September 2025 to September 2026, listings of condos and townhomes in Abbotsford peaked at 633 in May 2026 and bottomed at 399 in December 2025. Sales were strongest in March 2026 with 105. The reported sale price moved from $495,200 to $497,500, a change of +0.5%.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
